newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - COCOA LIKELY TO RISE BUT NEEDS MORE BASE.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - COCOA LIKELY TO RISE BUT NEEDS MORE BASE.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa futures should resume their gentle upwards push on Tuesday but nearby September will need to build more of a support base if last month's peaks are to be challenged, technical analysts said.
September had clawed back some of the ground lost since it slid to a 965 stg trough late last month, and was preparing for a test of the upper end of the July trading range.

But analysts suggested a more solid support base would be required if the contract was to muster enough momentum to reach the month's peak at 1,087 stg, also the springboard into the higher June range.
"It's slightly improved...and I think there's a reasonable chance it could go up and look at the early July highs," said Susan Rigg, an analyst at Chart Analysis.
"However, I don't think we're going to go up to the peaks again because it hasn't done enough base-building."

Traders noted that price movements still depended heavily on fluctuations in the sterling/dollar rate and called the London market to open 10 stg higher than Friday's close, based on a rate of $1.5790.
London ended tightly mixed on Monday, with the nearby months firmer in very quiet trade.

But a mixture of speculative and commercial buying spurred New York to close broadly higher and towards the top of the day's range, although much of the activity focused on the nearby September/December switch.
Rigg saw a fair amount of resistance impeding attempts at a rally, but prices seemed to have completed their break below the psychological 1,000 mark and were preparing to move higher.
"It's trying to knock the range highs we saw at the end of July and beginning of August," she said.
"We have a fair downward break beneath the 1,000 area so there is a good chance it could look at the upside."
